title: Networking
description: Practices for robust network clients and servers.

practices.title: Timeout everything
practices.statement: Every network call has an explicit timeout; blocking forever is a defect.

practices.title: Handle partial I/O
practices.statement: Treat short reads and writes as normal, not as errors or as completion.

practices.title: Backoff on reconnect
practices.statement: Reconnect with exponential backoff and jitter; never hot-loop a dead peer.

practices.title: Verify the peer
practices.statement: TLS verification stays enabled; disabling it requires documented justification.

practices.title: Bound concurrency
practices.statement: Bound connections and in-flight requests to prevent resource exhaustion.
